# andrewjparkus.github.io

The public site for a multi-league (NBA / G-League / college) RAPM analytics project — player ratings,
career trajectories, a 2026-27 season projection, team pages, and an accuracy scoreboard.

**This repository is GENERATED — do not edit by hand.** The HTML/JS/CSS pages and all JSON data here are
built by a deploy script in the private source project and copied into this checkout (the build clears
everything here except `.git` on each deploy). Any manual edit is overwritten on the next publish.

- Source of truth: the private `unified-rapm` project (site source + JSON exporters).
- Published manually by the owner after a full site rebuild.

Live site: https://andrewjparkus.github.io
